newsitem.title: USA: US corporate bonds end flat, few issues active.
newsitem.headline: US corporate bonds end flat, few issues active.

text.p: U.S. investment-grade and high-yield corporate bonds closed mostly unchanged on Wednesday, with trade isolated to a handful of issues, dealers in both markets said.
In high-quality debt, Motorola debentures inched lower after the company said its projected third-quarter earnings could fall 25 percent or more from the previous period.
Yield spreads on Motorola Inc's 7.50 percent debentures due 2025 widened by two basis points at a 53 bid, 50 offer.
Standard & Poor's analyst Bruce Hyman said the earnings warning had no immediate impact on the firm's credit ratings.
